items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: on that label, I released Ike Isaacs' album called The Pied Piper with Jack Wilson and Jimmie Smith and Ike Isaacs

ctx.x: Right. He has taken over your catalogue or just the name?

Just the name Legend. Also, we have another label, RGB, which stands for Red, Grover and Buddy. So there are just three of us now that maintain a label. And on that label, I released Ike Isaacs' album called The Pied Piper with Jack Wilson and Jimmie Smith and Ike Isaacs, who died a couple of years ago.
